permitDetails.extractionNotes: Permit number from cover/header ('Permit No. PTI0000052 v1.0'). Issuance date from 'DATE PERMIT TO INSTALL APPROVED: November 8, 2024'. State Registration Number 'B1557' used as stateFacilityID. Facility address kept with line break as shown. No explicit expiration date stated.

generatorSets.operatingHoursPerUnitRollingWindow: per 12-month rolling time period as determined at the end of each calendar month.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The permittee may operate each engine in FGEMGENS for no more than 100 hours per calendar year for the purpose of necessary maintenance checks and readiness testing, provided that the tests are recommended by Federal, State, or local government, the manufacturer, the vendor, the regional transmission organization or equivalent balancing authority and transmission operator, or the insurance company associated with the engine. The permittee may petition the Department for approval of additional hours to be used for maintenance checks and readiness testing. A petition is not required if the owner or operator maintains records indicating that Federal, State, or local standards require maintenance and testing of emergency internal combustion engines beyond 100 hours per calendar year. (40 CFR 60.4211(f)(2)) Each engine in FGEMGENS may operate up to 50 hours per calendar year in non-emergency situations, but those 50 hours are counted towards the 100 hours per calendar year provided for maintenance and testing as provided in §60.4211(f)(2). Except as provided in §60.4211(f)(3)(i), the 50 hours per calendar year for non-emergency situations cannot be used for peak shaving or non-emergency demand response, or to generate income for the permittee to supply non-emergency power as part of a financial arrangement with another entity. (40 CFR 60.4211(f)(3))
generatorSets.extractionNotes: Rated 2000 kW and 18.76 MMBtu/hr from Emission Unit Summary Table. Fuel specification and grade from SC II.2. Sulfur content 0.15 percent by weight annual average (SC II.3) converted to decimal fraction per schema. Combined diesel fuel limit 44,567 gal/yr applies to FGEMGENS (SC II.1). Operating hour cap 500 hours per 12-month rolling period (SC III.1). Hour meter required per SC IV.1. General Condition 11 sets opacity 20% with one six-minute average per hour up to 27%.
